sql: SELECT "matches"."loser_id" AS k, (CAST("matches"."winner_ht" AS REAL) / "matches"."loser_ht") AS m1 FROM "matches" WHERE (CAST("matches"."winner_ht" AS REAL) / "matches"."loser_ht") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: matches.winner height relative to loser height
why: winner height / loser height: a ratio of two quantities in cm
rank matches rows by winner height relative to loser height

sql: SELECT "matches"."loser_id" AS k, ("matches"."loser_ht" - "matches"."winner_ht") AS m1 FROM "matches" WHERE ("matches"."loser_ht" - "matches"."winner_ht") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: loser height - winner height: both in cm and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one tennis match
rank matches rows by loser height minus winner height
